releaseNotes:
⚡ Complete Chat Context & Offline Catch-Up Engine (v1.0.6) by Dhiraj:
• 💬 Complete Message Context Saved: Fixed framework ArrayList bundle parsing so rapid messages and multi-message batches from WhatsApp are 100% captured without missing lines
• 🌐 Offline Data Catch-Up: When mobile data/WiFi is turned back on after being offline, MsgVault scans active notification chains and preserves all missed messages across all chats
• 🔝 Recent Saved Messages Always Above: Home screen conversation list strictly orders the most recently active chat at the very top (MAX timestamp ordering)
• 📜 Auto-Scroll to Latest: Chat details automatically open to the most recent messages
• 🎯 Exact Millisecond De-duplication: Rapid consecutive identical texts (e.g. 'ok', '?') are never dropped
• 100% Data Preservation: All existing chats and media remain intact
